title: Prompting for Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification
findings: The paper found that detecting religious hate in memes is a challenging task that requires deep contextual and cultural knowledge. For instance, understanding a meme targeting Muslims required knowing that pigs are considered unclean in Islam. The proposed model, PromptHate, still struggled with complex reasoning involving religious symbols, such as failing to correctly identify a meme as hateful where Jesus on a cross was depicted as a scarecrow.
